name: CYBERE
recent: 公司近期宣布以 RM15.0 million 收购位于 Dengkil 的三块永久业权商业用地，并披露独立估值为 RM18.0 million。同时，公司将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开第九届常年股东大会，并发布 2026 年年报。此外，大股东及董事在 10 月有多笔股份交易。
notable: 拟以 RM15.0 million 收购 Dengkil 三块永久业权商业用地，独立估值为 RM18.0 million。
大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Dr Palaniappan A/L Ramanathan Chettiar 于 10 月 15 日间接增持 350,000 股。
集团董事总经理 Mr Maha Ramanathan Palan 于 10 月 13 日增持 17,000 股。

recent_en: The company recently announced the acquisition of three freehold commercial land parcels in Dengkil for RM15.0 million, with an independent valuation of RM18.0 million. There were also several share dealings by a major shareholder and directors in October.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of three freehold commercial land parcels in Dengkil for RM15.0 million, with an independent valuation of RM18.0 million.
Major shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Dr Palaniappan A/L Ramanathan Chettiar indirectly acquired 350,000 shares on 15 October.
Group Managing Director Mr Maha Ramanathan Palan acquired 17,000 shares on 13 October.
